subject.title: Critical: Gateway Memory Leak — RSS grows from 350MB to 15.5GB over days, causing repeated OOM crashes

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for unresolved Gateway RSS growth while startup readiness and configurable memory thresholds are handled as separate focused work?
rationale: The discussion now combines several retention mechanisms with independent startup and configuration proposals, so maintainer intent is needed to establish a reviewable owner boundary and closure criterion.

options.title: Keep canonical tracker
options.body: Track unresolved multi-host RSS growth and degraded runtime behavior here, while moving readiness and threshold policy to narrower issues.

options.title: Narrow original OOM
options.body: Limit this issue to the original 15 GB crash mechanism and designate another existing issue as the canonical remaining memory tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical tracker
recommendation.body: Track unresolved multi-host RSS growth and degraded runtime behavior here, while moving readiness and threshold policy to narrower issues.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior broad long-running Gateway leak work is the strongest available history signal for deciding the remaining cross-path scope.
